messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these AI agents headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing, transitioning from experimental phases to critical production infrastructure. Open-source frameworks have hit a major milestone, with adoption tripling as model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has become the new benchmark for frontier models, ensuring more accurate execution. Multi-agent swarms are moving beyond mere demos into regulated enterprise workflows, signaling deep institutional trust. To support this complex deployment, observability standards are finally emerging, enabling end-to-end tracing of agent decisions and paving the way for safer, more transparent autonomous systems.
